#Upload packages
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(readxl)
library(patchwork)
library(lubridate)
library(MBA)
library(mgcv)
library(FNN)
library(zoo)
library(reshape2)
library(rioja)
library(egg)

# 2024 corrected buoy data
b24 <- read.csv(here("outputs", "buoy_corr_dm_2024.csv"))

bsal <- read.csv(here("files", "buoy_salinity.csv"))

#Corrected CTD data
f <- read_csv(here("outputs", "kc10_npq_test.csv"))

env <- read_csv(here("outputs", "enviro_5m_2025-04-25_kc10.csv"))

env_anom <- read_csv(here("outputs", "ctd_anom_week_2025-04-25_kc10.csv"))

#Downloading discrete chlorophyll samples
cd <- read_csv(here("files", "2024-12-05_HakaiData_chlorophyll.csv"))

wind <- read_csv(here("files", "wind_all.csv"))

wind_anom <- read.csv(here("outputs", "wind_anom_day_2025-04-25.csv"))

#CHEMTAX
chem <- read_csv(here("files", "chemtax_kc10_2024.csv"))

b24 <- b24 %>% 
  select(date_corr, fl_med_day, group) %>% 
  distinct()

bsal <- bsal %>% 
  mutate(date = mdy(date)) %>% 
  filter(WaterSalinity_UQL == 2 & year == 2024) %>% 
  filter(!date == "2024-02-12")

f24 <- f %>% 
  filter(date > "2024-01-01")

wind <- wind %>% 
  mutate(date = mdy(date))

wind24 <- wind %>% 
  filter(year == 2024)
  
cd <- cd %>% 
  filter(filter_type == "Bulk GF/F" & line_out_depth == 0) %>% 
  select(date, chla)
b24 <- b24 %>% 
  mutate(date = lubridate::ymd(date_corr),
         year = lubridate::year(date),
         yday = lubridate::yday(date)) 

b24 <- b24 %>% 
  left_join(cd) %>% 
  left_join(bsal)
#Working with chemtax data to make it easy to plot

#Making the date column a date format
chem <- chem %>% 
  mutate(date2 = lubridate::mdy(Date)) 

#Selecting appropriate columns and renaming to easy to work with names
chem <- chem %>%
  select(date = date2, cyan = Cyanobacteria, hapt = Hapto, 
         GA = `Prasinophytes-3`, cryp = Cryptophytes,
         dino = `Dinoflagellates-1`, raph = Raphido,
         dict = Dictyo, diat = `Diatoms-1`)

#Pivoting to long/tidy for plotting in ggplot
chem <- chem %>% 
  pivot_longer(c(cyan:diat), names_to = "group", values_to = "contribution")

#Calculating TChla for each sample
chem_tchla <- chem %>% 
  group_by(date, group) %>% 
  summarise(contribution = mean(contribution)) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  group_by(date) %>% 
  mutate(tchla = sum(contribution)) %>% 
  ungroup()


#checking to see if there are any duplicates - there were replicates taken for DFO comparisons. None found because I already averaged these for the manuscript.
chem_dup <- chem_tchla %>%
  distinct(date, tchla) %>% 
  group_by(date) %>% 
  mutate(dup = n()) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  filter(dup > 1)

wind_anom <- wind_anom %>% 
  mutate(date = parse_date_time(x = paste(year, yday), orders = "yj"),
         date = ymd(date)) %>% 
  mutate(pos = anom >= 0) %>% 
  filter(year == "2024")

wind24 <- wind24 %>% 
  mutate(date = ymd(date))
f1 <- ggplot() + 
  # geom_area(data = wind_24, aes(x = date, speed_dm^3),
  #           fill = "grey", alpha = 0.7) +
  # geom_col(data = wind_anom, aes(x = date, y = anom, fill = pos)) +
  # annotate("rect", xmin = date("2024-07-02"), xmax = date("2024-07-24"),
  #          ymin = 0, ymax = Inf, fill = 'grey', alpha = 1) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = as_date("2024-03-18"),
             linetype = "solid", size = 1, color = "black") +
  geom_line(data = wind24, aes(x = date, y = WindSpd_Med^3),
            size = 2) +
  annotate("text", x = as.Date("2024-01-15"), y = 3500,
           label = "a)",
           size = 10) +
  annotate("text", x = as.Date("2024-04-15"), y = 3500,
           label = "2024 SB",
           size = 10) +

  labs(y = bquote(Wind~"("*m^3~s^-3*")")) +
  scale_x_date(limits = as_date(c("2024-01-01", "2024-12-31")),
               expand = c(0, 0),date_breaks = "months", date_labels = "%b") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(text = element_text(size = 35), #35
        axis.text = element_text(color = "black"),
        axis.title.x = element_blank(),
        axis.text.x = element_blank())
anom_dr <- env_anom %>% 
  filter(par == "dr" & year == 2024) %>% 
  mutate(pos = anom >= 0) 

anom_fwc <- env_anom %>% 
  filter(par == "fwc" & year == 2024) %>% 
  mutate(pos = anom >= 0) 

env <- env %>% 
  filter(date >= "2024-01-01")

  ggplot() + 
  # geom_area(data = anom_fwc, aes(x = year_month, y = anom*coeff),

b24_long <- b24 %>%
  select(date_corr, group, chla, fl_med_day, WaterSalinity_Avg) %>% 
  pivot_longer(c(chla, fl_med_day, WaterSalinity_Avg),
              names_to = "par", values_to = "val") %>% 
  mutate(date = date(date_corr))
f3 <- b24_long %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = date, y = val, color = par)) +
  annotate("rect", xmin = date("2024-03-05"), xmax = date("2024-04-30"),
           ymin = 0, ymax = Inf, fill = 'darkgreen', alpha = 0.2) +
  geom_line(data = filter(b24_long,
                          par == "fl_med_day" & group == 1),
            size = 2) +
  geom_line(data = filter(b24_long,
                          par == "fl_med_day" & group == 2),
            size = 2) +
  geom_line(data = filter(b24_long,
                          par == "WaterSalinity_Avg"),
            size = 2) +
  geom_point(data = filter(b24_long,
                          par == "chla"),
            size = 4, pch = 8, stroke = 2) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = as_date("2024-03-18"),
             linetype = "solid", size = 1, color = "black") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = as_date("2024-04-06"),
             linetype = "dashed", size = 1, color = "black") +
  annotate("text", x = as.Date("2024-01-15"), y = 21,
           label = "b)",
           size = 10) +
  ggsci::scale_color_jama(labels = c(expression(Chl[Discrete]),
                                         expression(Chl[BUOY]),
                                         expression(Salinity[BUOY]))) +
  scale_x_date(limits = as_date(c("2024-01-01", "2024-12-31")),
               expand = c(0, 0),date_breaks = "months", date_labels = "%b") +
  ylab(expression(atop(Chl~"(mg" ~ m^-3*")",
                       paste("Salinity")))) +
  labs(color = NULL) +
  
  # labs(y = bquote(Buoy[FLU]~"(mg" ~ m^-3*")"),
  #      x  = NULL,
  #      color = NULL) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(legend.position = "right",
        text = element_text(size = 35), #35
        axis.text = element_text(color = "black"),
        axis.title.x = element_blank(),
        axis.text.x = element_blank())

b24 %>%

            size = 2) +

            size = 2) +
  geom_line(data = b24, aes(x = date, y = WaterSalinity_Avg),
            size = 2, color = "darkblue") +
  geom_point(aes(x = date, y = chla, color = as.factor(year)),
             size = 4, pch = 8, color = "black", stroke = 2) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = as_date("2024-03-18"),
             linetype = "solid", size = 1, color = "black") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = as_date("2024-04-06"),
             linetype = "dashed", size = 1, color = "black") +
  ggsci::scale_color_futurama() +
  scale_x_date(
               expand = c(0, 0),date_breaks = "months", date_labels = "%b") +
  ylab(expression(atop(Buoy[FLU]~"(mg" ~ m^-3*")",

#Convert to a datetime so I can plot months.
# Option 3: Viridis-inspired but with dark blue start
fluor_palette_v3 <- colorRampPalette(c(
  "#08306b",  # Deep navy blue
  "#1f4e7a",  # Dark blue
  "#2e6b89",  # Medium blue
  "#4d8fc7",  # Bright blue
  "#2fb3d4",  # Vivid cyan-blue (bloom threshold)
  "#00a693",  # Bright teal
  "#4daf4a",  # Vibrant green
  "#8cc152",  # Lime green
  "#ffd23f",  # Bright yellow
  "#ff8c42",  # Vivid orange
  "#e74c3c"   # Bold red-orange
))

colors_v3 <- fluor_palette_v3(50)

create_fluor_breaks <- function(max_val = 50, bloom_threshold = 5) {
  # More breaks in the 0-10 range to capture bloom dynamics
  c(0, 1, 2, 3, 4, bloom_threshold, 7, 10, 15, 20, 30, 40, max_val)
}
#Now plot 2024 CTD profiles
# f2 <- 
  
f4 <- f24 %>% 
  mutate(day = 15,
         year = year(date),
         month = month(date)) %>% 
  unite(date_2, c(year, month, day), sep = "-", remove = F) %>% 
  mutate(date_2 = date(date_2)) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = date)) +
  geom_tile(aes(y = pres, fill = f_npq)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = as_date("2024-03-18"),
             linetype = "solid", size = 1, color = "white") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 5,
             linetype = "dashed", size = 1, color = "white") +
  annotate("text", x = as.Date("2024-01-15"), y = 5,
           label = "c)",
           size = 10) +
  annotate("text", x = as.Date("2024-11-19"), y = 9,
           label = "5m",
           size = 10,
           color = "white") +
  scale_y_reverse(breaks = seq(0, 50, by = 10)) +
  # cmocean::scale_fill_cmocean(name = "delta",
  #                             limits = c(0, 20),
  #                             oob = scales::squish) +
  # scale_fill_viridis_c(limits = c(0, 10),
  #                      oob = scales::squish) +
  scale_fill_gradientn(colors = colors_v3,
                       values = scales::rescale(c(0, 2, 5, 10, 20, 50))) +
  labs(fill = bquote(CTD[FLU]~"(mg" ~ m^-3*")"),
       y = "Depth") +
  scale_x_date(limits = as_date(c("2024-01-01", "2024-12-31")),
               expand = c(0, 0),date_breaks = "months", date_labels = "%b") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(text = element_text(size = 38), #35
        axis.text = element_text(color = "black"),
        axis.title.x = element_blank(),
        # axis.text.x = element_blank(),
        legend.position = "right",
        legend.key.height = unit(1.8, "cm"),
        legend.title = element_text(size = 30, angle = 270),
        legend.title.align = 0.5,
        legend.direction = "vertical",
        axis.text.x = element_blank()
        ) +
    guides(fill = guide_colourbar(title.position = "right"))

  # theme(text = element_text(size = 35), #35
  #       axis.text = element_text(color = "black"),
  #       axis.title.x = element_blank(),
  #       legend.position = "top",
  #       legend.box = "horizontal") +
  # guides(fill = guide_colourbar(title.position = "top", title.hjust = 0.5,
  #                               barwidth = 50, barheight = 1,
  #                               frame.colour = "black", ticks.colour = "black"))
fig <- (f1 / f2 / f3 / f4) 

test <- ggarrange(f1, f2, f3, f4, ncol = 1)


  

ggsave(here("figures", "panel_qu39_2024.png"), test,
        width = 16, height = 16, dpi = 300)

#Setting plotting order phytoplankton groups

#Order phytoplankton groups roughly from smallest to largest - create order list
order_chem <- c("cyan", "hapt", "GA", "cryp",
                   "dino", "raph", "dict", "diat")

#Chemtax full data - Specify order of phyto groups for figures
chem_tchla <- arrange(mutate(chem_tchla,
                                group = factor(group,
                                levels = order_chem)))

# Alternative version with more distinct colors (no similar reds)
npg_distinct_colors <- c(
  "#E64B35",  # Red
  "#4DBBD5",  # Light blue  
  "#00A087",  # Teal
  "#3C5488",  # Dark blue
  "#F39B7F",  # Orange
  "#8491B4",  # Purple
  "#91D1C2",  # Light teal
  "#FFC107",  # Golden yellow (replacing second red)
  "#7E6148",  # Brown
  "#B09C85"   # Light brown
)

scale_fill_npg_distinct <- function(...) {
  ggplot2::scale_fill_manual(values = npg_distinct_colors, ...)
}
f5 <- chem_tchla %>%
  ggplot() +
  # annotate("rect", xmin = date("2024-03-05"), xmax = date("2024-04-30"),
  #          ymin = 0, ymax = Inf, fill = 'darkgreen', alpha = 0.2) +
  geom_bar(aes(date, contribution, fill = fct_rev(group)),
           position = "stack", stat = "identity",
           alpha = 1, color = "black", size = 1) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = as_date("2024-03-18"),
             linetype = "solid", size = 1, color = "black") +
  annotate("text", x = as.Date("2024-01-15"), y = 5.4,
           label = "d)",
           size = 10) +
  annotate("text", x = as.Date("2024-12-15"), y = 5.4,
           label = "5m",
           size = 10) +
  scale_fill_npg_distinct() +
  # lims(y = c(0, 5)) +
  scale_x_date(limits = as.Date(c("2024-01-01", "2024-12-31")),
               expand = c(0, 0),
               date_breaks = "months", date_labels = "%b") +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(y = bquote("Phyto. (mg" ~ m^-3*")"),
       fill = "Group") +
  theme(
        legend.position = "right",
        # legend.position = c(1.02, 0.5),
        legend.key.height = unit(0.5, "cm"),
        # legend.text = element_text(size = 25),
        legend.title = element_blank(),
        text = element_text(size = 38), #35
        axis.text = element_text(color = "black"),
        axis.title.x = element_blank())
        # axis.text.y = element_blank())
test2 <- ggarrange(f1, f3, f4, f5, ncol = 1)


  

ggsave(here("figures", "panel_qu39_2024_CHEMTAX_2_color_v1.png"), test2,
